delete.description: Delete an asset, its original and every rendition (also cancels an unfinished upload).

post.description: Process a failed asset again from the original upload.
Exchange email + password for an access token and a refresh cookie.
Revoke this login's refresh tokens and clear the cookie.
Rotate the refresh cookie and return a new access token.
Create an account and start a session.

get.description:
Live asset and export state (SSE). Events: `snapshot` (JSON list of assets), then `asset`
and `export` (JSON objects) as they change.
The user's server exports (of one project, if given), newest first.

post.description: Export a composition on the server. The project is copied as it is now.

delete.description: Remove an export and its file (a running one is cancelled first).

get.description: One export, with a download link when it is done.

post.description: Stop an export that hasn't finished (the worker notices within a few frames).

get.description: Readiness of every backing service. 200 when all are ok, 503 otherwise.
The user's projects, most recently saved first (without their documents).

post.description: Create a project with one empty composition.

put.description:
Save the whole document. `If-Match` is the version it was loaded or last saved at; a stale
version gets 412 with the current version in the `ETag` header.

post.description: Keep a restorable copy of the project as it is stored now.

Make the snapshot's document the current one (as a new version, so it can be undone by
restoring an earlier snapshot).
Start a resumable upload; the asset appears in the library as `uploading`.

get.description: Which parts storage already has; used to resume after a refresh or network loss.

post.description: Verify every part arrived, assemble the file and queue it for processing.
Presigned PUT URLs for the given part numbers (1-based).
